title: The C2.6 closeout amendment — receipt identity mandatory, the renderer status mandatory on both sides, the watchdog's R3/R6 made evidence-producing, and the one blocked-terminal browser attack
author: Coder 2 (presentation layer)
directive: Operator directive R451-C2.6 CLOSEOUT AMENDMENT (a closure amendment to C2.6 ONLY; do not create C2.7). Fix only the named authority holes; exactly one blocked-terminal browser attack; preserve the positive control; do not touch Coder 1's scientific machinery; PR #5 / r449-c2/visual-benchmark @ bd7a12df is the canonical C2.6 line and PR #6 must not supersede it; re-verify locally, then stop; production is the NEXT authority test.
round_question: Can the release chain still be reached through an omitted or mismatched receipt identity, a missing renderer status on either side of the success-record pair, an undeterminable presentation artifact set under a COMPLETE_PASS gate, a hard-coded watchdog pass, or a stale scientific verdict on a blocked-terminal surface — and can the fully valid chain still reach VISUAL_READY?
answer: NO for every attack — measured: the chain's invocation_receipt_identity rung now REQUIRES run_id to exist (omission is never agreement) and the render_record_identity rung REQUIRES receipt.invocation_status AND render_record.status to exist and be equal (a missing status on either side fails closed); the watchdog's R3 converts a missing/uninspectable node_count, a failed visual-set derivation, or an unknown required artifact set under a TRUE COMPLETE_PASS antecedent into an integrity finding (never NOT_APPLICABLE — that state is legal only when the antecedent is genuinely false); the watchdog's R6 no longer hard-codes ok=True but derives the canonical projection from the run's own records via build_dossier and passes only on the typed non-ready upstream state with no fabricated RECEIVED milestone; and the real-browser blocked-terminal attack proves the stale scientific verdict, the rejection surface, 'Technology ready', the visual-ready ribbon, and the model viewer are ALL absent while the InfrastructureBlockedHero is present. The positive control still reaches geometry_available + ENGINEERING + VISUAL_READY + watchdog PASS.

req_3_watchdog_r3_fail_closed.what: R3_complete_pass_has_full_ladder: the antecedent is now exactly verdict == COMPLETE_PASS. Under the TRUE antecedent, a node_count that is missing or uninspectable (the render-record field absent/uninspectable AND the structural GLB inspection failed), a failed visual-set derivation (required_artifacts raised — previously an UNCAUGHT crash path in the watchdog), or an unknown required artifact set is an INTEGRITY FINDING (violation_class RECORD_INVARIANT) — never NOT_APPLICABLE. NOT_APPLICABLE occurs ONLY when the antecedent is genuinely false (verdict != COMPLETE_PASS). Watchdog version disclosure bumped to R451-C2.6-CLOSEOUT.

req_4_r6_evidence_from_the_run.what: The hard-coded ok=True (which pointed at tests/test_r451_c2_blocked_state.py instead of producing evidence) is DELETED. XXV), never a pass. The rule's detail carries the derived evidence (geometry_state, engineering row status, visualization row status).
